name: kneeling chest stretch
description: Kneeling with your arms reaching forward onto a support lets your chest sink down. It stretches the chest and shoulders.
instructions: Kneel in front of a bench or chair and rest your forearms or hands on it.
Sit your hips back and let your chest drop toward the floor until you feel the stretch.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.
